survivor_reasons.reason: equivalent mutant: with the registeredHere guard intact no verb this card owns is already present in commandHandlers, so the second guard is defence-in-depth and behaviourally unobservable. Not a coverage defect, but it means the check cannot distinguish guard 2 being present.

BLOCKER-class survivor: apps/cli/main.go no longer answers doctor (it falls through to the unknown-verb refusal, exit 3 NOT_IMPLEMENTED) while 46/46 stay green, because no row of the construction check invokes doctor and the coverage self-report is a hand-written table. grep finds no assertion for doctor anywhere in tests/, apps/ or bootstrap/.
W0503-HELP-COVERS-EVERY-COMMAND measures only len(commands)>=15, so a help record naming 17 strings that are not commands satisfies a row whose name claims coverage.

BLOCKER-class survivor: removing the requirement that a recorded settled run exists leaves a bare --settled flag sufficient to switch the model, and 46/46 stay green, because W0503-MODEL-CHANGE-NEEDS-SETTLED-CONFIRMATION only exercises the case with no --settled at all. This is the card-s named negative 静默模型切换.

W0503-NO-PROCESS-DELEGATION greps the text of apps/cli/cli_contract.go only, so os/exec delegation introduced in apps/cli/cli_http.go (same package, same delivered card) is invisible; the card-s named negative shell-alias-to-another-vendor-CLI is guarded for one of three CLI files this card delivered.

the digest row compares bytes, and two builds of one source emit a byte-identical version record, so W0503-DISTRIBUTION-SELFREPORT-DIGEST-MATCHES-INDEPENDENT-LAUNCH cannot fail for the reason its name states. Mitigated by the check-s own independent launch of target/researchos.exe, which R09 shows really does gate on the space/non-ASCII path.

classification_glossary.caught-by-named-id: one of the rows this mutant was written to attack went red
classification_glossary.caught-by-gate-id-only: the run went red but not by any row the mutant targeted
classification_glossary.survived: the run stayed PASS 46 with the defect present
classification_glossary.anchor-missing: the edit anchor did not occur exactly once so the mutant never ran
classification_glossary.crashed-mutant-ill-formed: the mutant did not compile (none occurred; every mutant here compiled and ran)

restores_verified: every one of the 10 mutants restored byte-exact to the digest the executor registered in execution/v2.4/step_state.json; git status --porcelain for all five mutated paths empty after each restore and at the end
